ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) Districts symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 20-B in the area bound by:

East 80" Street; South Exchange Avenue; a line 149 feet north of East 81%
Street; the alley next west of and parallel to South Exchange Avenue: East 80°
Street; South Houston Avenue; East 81 Street, and South Muskegon Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
